name: ForceDream

hlido_opinion.headline: A genuinely agent-native execution runtime — discover, price, execute and cryptographically verify agent work over A2A/MCP — wrapped in oversized "sovereign OS" language and still very small.
hlido_opinion.body: Underneath the maximalist branding ('the sovereign AI operating system', 'sovereign intelligence'), ForceDream is doing something concrete and unusually on-thesis for an agent-to-agent world: it runs a live A2A + MCP marketplace where an agent can discover a capability with no API key, get a firm price before work starts, execute over JSON-RPC, and receive an Ed25519 + Merkle-signed proof any third party can verify without an account. It publishes to the Google Agent Registry and the official MCP registry, implements A2A v0.3.0 and v1.0, exposes 17 MCP tools (five credential-free), and ships proof SDKs across twelve languages gated in CI. For a register that cares about machine-readability and verifiability first, those are real credits. The reasons to stay measured: the scale is tiny and stated as such (17 agents, ~5,000 audit records), so this is early infrastructure, not a proven economy; the verification and 'zero altered' claims are exactly what needs independent auditing rather than being taken from the marketing surface; and the sovereign-OS framing oversells what is, today, a niche verifiable-execution runtime. Promising and legible to agents — but small and unproven.

tier_rationale: STEADY (70), on the border: a genuinely agent-native design (credential-free discovery/quoting, A2A + MCP, cryptographically verifiable proofs, twelve SDKs, registered where agents look) earns real credit for machine-readability. Held at the band floor because the scale is tiny and self-stated (17 agents, ~5,000 records), the integrity/"zero altered" claims are unaudited from the public surface, and the "sovereign OS" framing overstates a still-niche runtime.
what_it_does_well: Credential-free agent discovery and price-quoting before any work starts (no API key required)
Cryptographically verifiable outputs (Ed25519 + Merkle) any third party can check without an account
Standards-based: A2A v0.3.0/v1.0 + a real MCP server (17 tools), published to the Google Agent Registry and official MCP registry
Twelve language SDKs against one proof spec, gated in CI
Machine-readable throughout (agent-card.json, documented endpoints) — legible to other agents first
what_it_fails_at: Very small scale, self-stated (17 agents, ~5,000 audit records) — early infrastructure, not a proven economy
Integrity claims ("zero altered", WORM-sealed) are unaudited from the public surface
Grandiose "sovereign intelligence OS" framing oversells the current, niche reality
Split public presence (forcedream.ai technical surface vs forcedream.com) can confuse buyers
best_for: Developers building A2A or MCP agents who want priced, verifiable third-party capabilities
Teams that need cryptographic proof of what an agent did, verifiable by outside parties
Early adopters exploring an open, standards-based agent economy
not_recommended_for: Production workloads needing scale, uptime history, or an audited integrity guarantee today
Buyers put off by maximalist framing who want claims independently verified first
Non-technical users — this is a developer/agent-facing runtime
red_flags: "AUDIT RECORDS VERIFIED, ZERO ALTERED" and WORM integrity are asserted on the marketing surface without independent audit
Maximalist "sovereign intelligence OS" positioning is disproportionate to the stated scale

evidence_urls.claim: Credential-free discovery and quoting over A2A (POST /v1/discover, /v1/agents/quote)
MCP server with 17 tools, five requiring no credentials
Published to Google Agent Registry and the official MCP registry; A2A v0.3.0/v1.0
Ed25519 + Merkle proofs; 5,000 audit records, zero altered

agent_relevance.agent_integration_path: High by design: a live MCP server (17 tools) and A2A v0.3.0/v1.0 runtime with credential-free discovery/quoting, machine-readable agent cards, and twelve proof SDKs. Registered in agent indexes. Not behaviourally verified by Hlido from the public surface; scale is small.

checklist.evidence: Discover, price, execute and verify agent work over A2A/MCP
'Control Room' / 'API access' / signup returns a key immediately
Per-successful-call billing; discovery/quoting credential-free; instant self-serve key
Documented live endpoints, verification endpoints, 3D agent-network view
